import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    
    static int[][] capacity = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+10][MAXN*MAXN*2+10];
    static int[][] flow = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+10][MAXN*MAXN*2+10];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+10];
    static int[] num = new int[MAXN*MAXN*2+10];
    static int N, T, source_node, sink_node;
    
    static int node_id(int r, int c) {
        return (r-1)*N + c;
    }
    
    static boolean is_valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 1 && r <= N && c >= 1 && c <= N;
    }
    
    static void connect(int u, int v, int c) {
        capacity[u][v] += c;
    }
    
    static int push_flow(int u, int bottleneck) {
        if (u == sink_node) return bottleneck;
        int total_pushed = bottleneck, delta, min_dist = N*N*2+2;
        for (int v = 0; v < N*N*2+2; ++v) {
            if (capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) {
                if (dist[u] == dist[v] + 1) {
                    delta = push_flow(v, Math.min(total_pushed, capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v]));
                    flow[u][v] += delta;
                    flow[v][u] -= delta;
                    total_pushed -= delta;
                    if (dist[source_node] == N*N*2+2 || total_pushed == 0) return bottleneck - total_pushed;
                }
                min_dist = Math.min(min_dist, dist[v] + 1);
            }
        }
        if (total_pushed == bottleneck) {
            num[dist[u]]--;
            num[min_dist]++;
            if (num[dist[u]] == 0) dist[source_node] = N*N*2+2;
            dist[u] = min_dist;
        }
        return bottleneck - total_pushed;
    }
    
    static int compute_maxflow() {
        if (source_node == sink_node) return INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < N*N*2+2; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(flow[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(capacity[i], 0);
        }
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
        Arrays.fill(num, 0);
        int result = 0;
        while (dist[source_node] < N*N*2+2) {
            result += push_flow(source_node, INF);
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    static class Cell {
        int r, c, d;
        Cell(int r, int c, int d) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.d = d;
        }
    }
    
    static int[][] time_to_reach = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] visited_bfs = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int start_r, start_c;
    static final int[] dr = {0,0,-1,1};
    static final int[] dc = {-1,1,0,0};
    
    static void compute_times() {
        Queue<Cell> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new Cell(start_r, start_c, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(time_to_reach[i], 0x7f7f7f7f);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_bfs[i], false);
        }
        visited_bfs[start_r][start_c] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Cell cur = q.poll();
            time_to_reach[cur.r][cur.c] = cur.d;
            if (cur.d > T) break;
            for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                int nr = cur.r + dr[k], nc = cur.c + dc[k];
                if (is_valid(nr,nc) && grid1[nr][nc] != 'Y' && !visited_bfs[nr][nc]) {
                    Cell next = new Cell(nr, nc, cur.d+1);
                    visited_bfs[nr][nc] = true;
                    q.offer(next);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void explore_from(int r, int c) {
        Queue<Cell> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new Cell(r, c, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_bfs[i], false);
        }
        visited_bfs[r][c] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Cell cur = q.poll();
            if (cur.d > T) break;
            if (time_to_reach[cur.r][cur.c] < cur.d) continue;
            if (time_to_reach[cur.r][cur.c] == cur.d && (grid2[cur.r][cur.c] < '1' || grid2[cur.r][cur.c] > '9')) continue;
            if (grid2[cur.r][cur.c] >= '1' && grid2[cur.r][cur.c] <= '9') {
                if (cur.r != r || cur.c != c) {
                    connect(node_id(r,c), node_id(cur.r,cur.c) + N*N, INF);
                }
                if (time_to_reach[cur.r][cur.c] == cur.d) continue;
            }
            for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                int nr = cur.r + dr[k], nc = cur.c + dc[k];
                if (is_valid(nr,nc) && grid1[nr][nc] != 'Y' && !visited_bfs[nr][nc]) {
                    Cell next = new Cell(nr, nc, cur.d+1);
                    visited_bfs[nr][nc] = true;
                    q.offer(next);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid1[i] = new char[MAXN];
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid2[i] = new char[MAXN];
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        
        source_node = 0;
        sink_node = 2*N*N+1;
        
        for (int i=1; i<=N; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=N; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j]>='1' && grid1[i][j]<='9') {
                    connect(source_node, node_id(i,j), grid1[i][j]-'0');
                }
                if (grid1[i][j]=='Z') {
                    start_r = i; start_c = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i=1; i<=N; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=N; ++j) {
                connect(node_id(i,j), node_id(i,j)+N*N, INF);
                if (grid2[i][j]>='1' && grid2[i][j]<='9') {
                    connect(node_id(i,j)+N*N, sink_node, grid2[i][j]-'0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        compute_times();
        for (int i=1; i<=N; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=N; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j]>='1' && grid1[i][j]<='9') {
                    explore_from(i,j);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(compute_maxflow());
    }
}
